purpose: Persisted Phase 6 provider-execution state machine position. Resume only from nextAuthorizedState.

probe.providerMessage: API key not valid. Please pass a valid API key.

probeSoundnessControl.purpose: Prove the failure is the credential value and not a malformed probe.
probeSoundnessControl.interpretation: The two statuses differ, so the supplied value IS transmitted and parsed as a key and is then rejected on its value. A malformed or misrouted probe would not produce provider message 'API key not valid'.

notPerformed: No filesystem, .env, product configuration, user directory, shell history or secret store was searched for a credential.

environmentScopeDiagnosis.purpose: Distinguish a stale inherited process environment from a stale stored value. Only the named variable GEMINI_API_KEY was read, at its own scopes; no other variable, file or secret store was enumerated. No value was printed.
environmentScopeDiagnosis.conclusion: Not a process-inheritance problem. A child process cannot see a parent's post-launch environment edits, which would have shown Process stale and User current. Here the persisted User-scope value is itself 19 characters and not AIza-prefixed, so the variable that would be inherited by any newly launched process carries the same invalid value. Restarting the agent alone would not resolve this.
environmentScopeDiagnosis.expectedKeyShape: Google AI Studio keys are approximately 39 characters and begin with 'AIza'.

blocker.resolution: Set GEMINI_API_KEY to the valid key at User scope (or in the launching shell), confirm with a length/prefix check that it reads ~39 characters with an AIza prefix, then relaunch the agent so the new value is inherited, and resume from nextAuthorizedState.

artifactsNotCreated.reason: Their preconditions are downstream of AUTHENTICATED and none were reached.
